subject.title: Feature: Native Audio Input for Omni-Modal Models (skip STT transcription)

question: Should OpenClaw add native inbound audio forwarding for channel voice notes, and what typed media, provider egress, fallback, and transcript/audit contract should govern it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent solution changes provider routing, raw voice-byte egress, user-facing config/default policy, and session transcript semantics.

options.title: Design the native-audio contract first
options.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider serialization, opt-in egress policy, fallback behavior, payload limits, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

options.title: Keep STT-only for now
options.body: Keep inbound voice notes on the transcription path until maintainers are ready to own raw-media egress and replay semantics.

options.title: Use the open PR as an experiment
options.body: Continue with the open native audio/video PR only after it is rebased, proven, and reworked onto the approved contract.

recommendation.title: Design the native-audio contract first
recommendation.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider serialization, opt-in egress policy, fallback behavior, payload limits, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is across the media-understanding, LLM content, and adjacent provider contract surfaces.
